Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH team,

Your proposal explains the cost pressures in detail; it sounds like protecting a sustainable margin is central to this renewal. We value a lasting partnership that gives you dependable business and both sides planning certainty. How can a longer commitment help us agree a balanced renewal within your pricing constraints?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,580 units per year for 24 months. Our orders for Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 rose from EUR 400.19 to EUR 412.74 within 9 months (po:4500013355-10, po:4500014465-10). Our should-cost estimate for Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 is EUR 403.21 per 1 (cost:350020). Producer prices DE: electronic components changed -2.3% from 2025-01 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C2611@2025-01, idx:PPI-C2611@2025-10). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 430.81 per unit, 90 days payment, 24 months, 4,580 units a year). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION.
Our pricing follows our approval process.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

We have verified the labour cost index data you provided and incorporated it into our calculation. Regarding the index change data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. Material accounts for about 42 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Furthermore, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost. That remains. As our management has frozen price reductions, our flexibility on the base price remains strictly limited. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. We can therefore offer a slight adjustment to €429.18 for 4,580 units per year over a 36-month contract with 90 days payment terms.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot remains valid for 7 days. Our commercial parameters are a price of €429.18 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
